title: Reference microapps: opinionated SDK wiring for streaming + retry resilience
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a small collection of reference microapps (Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend, Go HTTP worker, and a CLI) that demonstrate opinionated wiring patterns for SDK usage: ergonomic streaming handlers, deterministic retry/backoff policies, token-aware batching hints, and simple interoperability between TypeScript, Python, and Go examples. These microapps should be minimal, copy-paste friendly, and highlight trade-offs for latency vs cost (e.g., batching windows, KV cache priming, optimistic streaming). The artifacts will be used by developer docs, onboarding, and internal examples repository.
acceptance_criteria: Four runnable examples in repository root under /examples: nextjs-streaming-chat, fastapi-async-proxy, go-http-connector, cli-batch-worker
Each example includes a README with setup steps, expected latency profiles, and how to toggle retry/backoff settings
Streaming examples show graceful resume on transient errors and a canonical client-side streaming handler for TS/Python/Go
Retry examples include idempotency key recommendations and deterministic backoff utility included in SDK snippets
CI smoke tests that start the FastAPI service and run an automated end-to-end request against hosted dev model (using local dev credentials)
PR with implementation, one design doc for API ergonomics, and one UX review approval from Developer Docs
implementation_notes: Prefer minimal third-party deps: Next.js for frontend, FastAPI + httpx for Python server, net/http for Go worker, and click for CLI
Expose configuration via env vars with example .env files; include token-cost and latency counters in logs
Use SDK helper utilities: RetryWithJitter, StreamingEventAdapter, and BatchHintContext (to be added to SDK core as small surface) - keep adapter code in examples if core changes are not ready
Highlight kernel scheduling/batching knobs in comments where applicable (sequence length, batch_window_ms)
test_plan: Unit tests for backoff utility (deterministic jitter with fixed seed)
Integration test: start fastapi example in CI, fire 100 streaming requests and assert 99% responses within 800ms median under dev workload
CLI smoke: run CLI worker against dev model for 50 short tasks and assert no crashes and retry behavior observed
Manual UX pass: engineer doc reviewer steps through Next.js demo and verifies streaming events surface cleanly in browser
